# Awesome Video Skills

> Model-specific video and motion workflows for file-reading agents. Offline curation and routing, not a generation service.

## Start
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): task, controller and provider separation.
- [Portable router skill](skills/video-router/SKILL.md): progressive disclosure and routing commands.
- [Decision flow](docs/decision-flow.md): choose procedural, generative, editing or hybrid work.
- [Controller profiles](docs/agents.md): Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and host discovery.

## Model and skill discovery
- [Model index](docs/model-index.md): exact versions, runtimes and backend surfaces.
- [Upstream skill catalog](docs/catalog.md): pinned paths, evidence and portability.
- [Motion graphics](docs/motion.md): Remotion, Hyperframes, Canvas, Manim and Blender.
- [Quality review](docs/quality.md): playback, audio, content and encoded metadata.

## Machine-readable interfaces
- [Discovery manifest](agent-manifest.json): project-specific navigation and CLI contract.
- [Navigation graph](registry/navigation.json): lanes, families, versions, providers and skills.
- [Retrieval chunks](registry/retrieval.jsonl): stable IDs and content hashes for indexing.
- [Request schema](schemas/request.schema.json): structured constraints.
- [Result schema](schemas/result.schema.json): candidate plans and explicit no-match responses.
- [Retrieval guide](docs/retrieval.md): BM25, structured filters and RAG ingestion.

## Evidence
- [Research coverage](research/coverage.md): sources, access gaps and limits.
- [Source registry](registry/sources.json): primary documentation.
- [Pin verification](research/pin-verification.json): immutable path/blob checks.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): inspection and execution boundaries.
